title: Cross-browser opt-in mechanism for install.sh: should the system-deps installati
question: Cross-browser opt-in mechanism for install.sh: should the system-deps installation (npx playwright install-deps webkit firefox) be gated by an explicit --with-cross-browser CLI flag, triggered by the presence of webkit/firefox in .cloverleaf/config/ui-review.json, or run unconditionally? The flag approach avoids config-at-install-time coupling and is predictable in CI environments but requires callers to opt in and a README note; the config-driven approach is ergonomic long-term but requires consumer config to exist before installation. A spike should evaluate platform-detection reliability (apt-only graceful no-op), assess how downstream consumers invoke install.sh today, and produce a recommendation with a concrete flag name or config-key convention.
